visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans through a glass storefront revealing a minimalist interior. A wooden table with glass flasks and yellow flowers is visible in the center under two large, round paper lanterns. (2) A young man with dark, styled hair, wearing a black puffer jacket over a white t-shirt, stands outside the shop holding a gimbal. He looks at the camera with a slight smile. The background shows an urban street with pedestrians. (3) The man is now inside, sitting on the curved sofa in the brightly lit studio space. He looks around the room. The lighting is bright and even, likely from large windows. (4) Close-up shots show framed art prints of human figures on the floor and walls. A wooden display table holds numerous perfume bottles and testing flasks arranged neatly. (5) A hand picks up a silver tube of hand cream. The scene shifts to the man holding a white scent card with a floral illustration. He holds it close to his nose, sniffing it, then presents various cards to the camera. (6) Detailed shots of perfume bottles labeled 'Sweet Dreams' and 'White Tuberose' are shown. The bottles are clear glass with white labels. (7) Outside, the man holds a large, dark brown plush teddy bear near his face, smiling warmly. He then holds up a large pink shopping bag with 'KINFOLK' printed on it. (8) The final shot is a low-angle view of the 'KINFOLK' building against a clear blue sky, showing its gray brick and concrete structure.
